development: E1 source shapes/outcomes are development knowledge. New 6 reserved source programs and their 120 inputs are excluded from implementation tuning. Generated typed selection probes are separate inputs and labelled synthetic; no forced selection supplied.
evaluation: 16 fixed programs, 360 evaluation cells. E1 cohort labelled known; 6 new sources/120 inputs reserved. Equal program/size/distribution weights, empty retained separately. All baseline/loss cases included.
lanes: Ordinary balanced compiler before/after with same fixed budgets and compiler binary when only planner/data changes; generated offline probes can produce checked choices. Explicit workload mode separately labelled. No measurements from evaluation fed selection.
limits: Partial typed kernels; no whole applications/CRDT/arbitrary JSON/new host operations. Synthetic probes are not evidence of actual user distribution. Eventful/stateful pipelines require supplied lifecycle data. Compile/proof/search/acquisition/setup separated.
raw: Randomized interleaved before/after repetitions, full output consumed and immutable inputs verified; paired uncertainty, raw samples retained.
baseline_status: Frozen before machinery edits; to be acquired with exact recorded source/pins.
